clauses.title: Late payment fee
clauses.text: A late payment fee is levied when the minimum amount due is not paid within 3 days after the payment due date. The fee depends on the total amount due on the statement: up to Rs 500 nil; Rs 501-5,000 Rs 500; Rs 5,001-10,000 Rs 750; Rs 10,001-25,000 Rs 950; Rs 25,001-50,000 Rs 1,100; above Rs 50,000 Rs 1,300. GST applies.

clauses.title: Finance charges on revolving balance
clauses.text: If the total amount due is not paid in full by the due date, finance charges of 3.75% per month apply on the outstanding balance from the date of each transaction until it is paid in full.

clauses.title: Goodwill reversal of late fee
clauses.text: One late payment fee may be reversed on request in any rolling 12-month period if the overdue amount was paid within 7 days of the due date.

clauses.title: Autopay failures
clauses.text: If an autopay debit fails, it is not retried automatically. The customer is notified and must pay through another channel before the due date to avoid late fees and finance charges.

clauses.title: Transaction disputes
clauses.text: A transaction may be disputed within 60 days of the transaction date. If the dispute is not resolved within 10 days, a temporary credit is posted. Disputes are resolved within 45 days.

clauses.title: Blocking a card
clauses.text: A card can be blocked immediately on request. For unauthorised transactions reported within 3 working days, the customer has zero liability.
